title: A visible old mark turns a CHSH excess from common funding into a usable message
subject: Locally readable old marked bits, two freely chosen messages selecting among local edit policies, a common visible funding event and equal fixed-address funding marginals.
conclusion: For local outputs that equal an old marked bit on a common gain and zero on every stall, a positive CHSH excess guarantees an ordinary bit-dependent message in either direction when fixed-address funding marginals agree. At a suitable receiver address the resulting total variation is at least the excess above two, even when neither observer can infer which edit repairs its shortage.
